name: bookcase
title: Interior furniture whose fronts use studs-out bricks: a bookcase in a door-frame carcass with panel shelves, a cabinet built lying down, a bracket sofa.
why: Furniture with studs-out fronts: a bookcase or cabinet for interiors.

name: pallet
title: A small plate pallet with leg plates underneath that leave fork slots, topped with stacked bricks and tiles as boxes; use it as forklift cargo.
why: A pallet with fork slots and stacked goods, for stations, warehouses, and loading docks.

name: grille_block
title: A small block of headlight bricks capped with grille pieces is built upright, then turned a quarter turn so its top becomes a vehicle's front grille with corner lamps.
why: A block of headlight bricks capped with grilles and turned a quarter turn, for a vehicle front or a machine.

name: wheel_plates
title: Wheels mount on plates with wheel pins (or on pins in Technic bricks) built into the chassis bottom layer; use it for any small vehicle axle, single or tandem.
why: Wheels on plates with wheel pins in the bottom layer of a chassis; the base of any small vehicle.

name: technic_spine
title: Two rows of Technic bricks lie side by side with their end joints offset and are pinned together sideways, making a long stiff beam for a chassis or boom.
why: A long stiff beam of Technic bricks with offset joints pinned together, for long floors and trailers.

name: arch_frame
title: Pairs of tall bricks stand on a floor at intervals, each pair is bridged by an arch, and a long roof spine locks onto the arch tops; use it to give a long box stiff cross-frames with open sides.
why: Pairs of pillars bridged by arches carrying a roof spine, for sheds and long halls.

name: stair_railing
title: Handrail of round-plate balusters with a long bar clipped to newel posts, or spindled fences capped by plates, for stairs and landings.
why: A handrail of round-plate balusters with a bar, for stairs and landings.

name: fascia_sign
title: Fascia board of stacked plates with clip plates holding a sign across it, for pub names and shop fascias.
why: A fascia board over a shopfront with a sign held by clips.

name: bar_balcony
title: Small rounded balcony with bar balusters that clips onto bar plates built into the wall under a door.
why: A small balcony that clips onto bars built into the wall under a door.

name: a_frame_sign
title: Two tiles with clips hang on the bars at each end of a small base and lean together to make a free-standing sidewalk sign.
why: A free-standing sidewalk sign of two tiles on clips.

name: rail_cornice
title: A molded edge on a porch roof or floor: a door-rail plate under a large plate so the rail shows as a cornice line.
why: A molded edge on a porch roof or floor from a door-rail plate.

name: pin_hung_chimney
title: A tall chimney built lying flat with Technic bricks inside, hung on Technic pins that stick out of the house wall.
why: A tall chimney built lying flat and hung on Technic pins from the wall.

name: grass_edge
title: Layered plates that overhang a cliff top unevenly to make an organic grassy edge; use on any landscape top.
why: A grassy edge that overhangs a cliff top unevenly.

name: shoreline
title: A ragged plate outline on a water baseplate with white tiles and cheese slopes scattered at the waterline as surf; use for islands and coasts.
why: A ragged shoreline with surf at the waterline on a water baseplate.

name: pier_deck
title: A pier or deck built studs-down with its side walls hung underneath, then flipped and tiled; use when a structure's sides and underside are what shows.
why: A deck or pier built upside down with its supports hanging under it, then flipped.

name: round_window
title: A round window or framed picture: a round 2x2 piece on the side studs of a side-stud brick in a wall course.
why: A round window or picture frame on the side studs of a brick in a wall course.

name: picket_corner
title: A fence corner with stacked 1x1 clip bricks as posts and picket sections between them.
why: A fence corner with 1 x 1 clip bricks as posts, so fence sections meet at any angle.

name: mirror_on_clip
title: A slope or tile on a plate with a clip is clipped onto a bar on the cab side as an adjustable side mirror.
why: A side mirror or small sign on a clip, adjustable on a bar.

name: mudflap
title: Square flags clip onto a bar held behind the rear wheels to hang as mudflaps.
why: Flags clipped onto a bar behind a vehicle's rear wheels.

name: bay_window
title: A faceted bay of separately built panels joined by vertical clip-and-bar hinges at the base, with the floor plate above locking the angles.
why: A faceted bay of window panels joined by clip hinges, the floor above fixing the angle.
